metadata.question: Was there more fire activity in August 2008 than in February 2008 in Thailand?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS/061/MOD14A1 (Daily active fire product) - Time periods: August 2008 (2008-08-01 to 2008-08-31) vs February 2008 (2008-02-01 to 2008-02-29) - Location: Thailand boundaries (approximate polygon or use center point with buffer) 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed - this is about fire detection - Use FireMask band: values 7-9 indicate fire pixels - Count fire pixels or sum fire mask values for each period 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - Valid Zero (B): Images exist, processing succeeds, but fire count in August <= February (legitimately less fire activity) - C1: No images found for one or both periods - C2: Images exist but after filtering/processing, 0 valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - A: Fire activity in August > February ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions # Thailand approximate bounding box thailand = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[97.3, 5.6], [105.6, 5.6], [105.6, 20.5], [97.3, 20.5], [97.3, 5.6]] ]) feb_start = '2008-02-01' feb_end = '2008-02-29' aug_start = '2008-08-01' aug_end = '2008-08-31' # 2. Data Acquisition fire_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') feb_col = fire_col.filterDate(feb_start, feb_end).filterBounds(thailand) aug_col = fire_col.filterDate(aug_start, aug_end).filterBounds(thailand) feb_size = feb_col.size().getInfo() aug_size = aug_col.size().getInfo() print(f"February 2008 images: {feb_size}") print(f"August 2008 images: {aug_size}") if feb_size == 0 or aug_size == 0: print("Missing data for one or both periods.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Count fire pixels # FireMask: 7=low confidence, 8=nominal confidence, 9=high confidence fire def count_fire_pixels(collection, region): def process_image(img): fire_mask = img.select('FireMask') # Fire pixels are values >= 7 fire_pixels = fire_mask.gte(7) return fire_pixels # Create composite of all fire detections fire_composite = collection.map(process_image).sum() # Count total fire pixel detections stats = fire_composite.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=region, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ) return stats.get('FireMask').getInfo() feb_fire_count = count_fire_pixels(feb_col, thailand) aug_fire_count = count_fire_pixels(aug_col, thailand) print(f"February fire detections: {feb_fire_count}") print(f"August fire detections: {aug_fire_count}") # 4. Validation & Final Answer if feb_fire_count is None or aug_fire_count is None: print("Calculation failed - returned None") print("C3") elif feb_fire_count == 0 and aug_fire_count == 0: print("No valid fire pixels detected in either period") print("C2") elif aug_fire_count > feb_fire_count: print("August had more fire activity than February") print("A") else: print("August did not have more fire activity than February") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Thailand approximate bounding box
thailand = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[97.3, 5.6], [105.6, 5.6], [105.6, 20.5], [97.3, 20.5], [97.3, 5.6]]
])

feb_start = '2008-02-01'
feb_end = '2008-02-29'
aug_start = '2008-08-01'
aug_end = '2008-08-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition
fire_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1')

feb_col = fire_col.filterDate(feb_start, feb_end).filterBounds(thailand)
aug_col = fire_col.filterDate(aug_start, aug_end).filterBounds(thailand)

feb_size = feb_col.size().getInfo()
aug_size = aug_col.size().getInfo()

print(f"February 2008 images: {feb_size}")
print(f"August 2008 images: {aug_size}")

if feb_size == 0 or aug_size == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or both periods.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Count fire pixels
    # FireMask: 7=low confidence, 8=nominal confidence, 9=high confidence fire
    def count_fire_pixels(collection, region):
        def process_image(img):
            fire_mask = img.select('FireMask')
            # Fire pixels are values >= 7
            fire_pixels = fire_mask.gte(7)
            return fire_pixels
        
        # Create composite of all fire detections
        fire_composite = collection.map(process_image).sum()
        
        # Count total fire pixel detections
        stats = fire_composite.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
            geometry=region,
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        )
        return stats.get('FireMask').getInfo()
    
    feb_fire_count = count_fire_pixels(feb_col, thailand)
    aug_fire_count = count_fire_pixels(aug_col, thailand)
    
    print(f"February fire detections: {feb_fire_count}")
    print(f"August fire detections: {aug_fire_count}")
    
    # 4. Validation & Final Answer
    if feb_fire_count is None or aug_fire_count is None:
        print("Calculation failed - returned None")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif feb_fire_count == 0 and aug_fire_count == 0:
        print("No valid fire pixels detected in either period")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif aug_fire_count > feb_fire_count:
        print("August had more fire activity than February")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("August did not have more fire activity than February")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
